response.original_title: Keep Believing | The Story of Helicopter Sunday
response.overview: This feature-length documentary revisits the extraordinary events of Helicopter Sunday through the voices of those who were there. Featuring insight from former Rangers players and staff, as well as fans and figures who were at Easter Road and Fir Park that day, the film tells the inside story of 22 May 2005 — when the title race took an unforgettable final twist. This is the definitive account of a day that has gone down in football folklore.
response.tagline: The most dramatic day in Scottish football history.
response.title: Keep Believing | The Story of Helicopter Sunday
